3042e2dbd28723fe6ea76b7032c26358893758cc.summary: SentinelOne reports a second victim of the TraderTraitor macOS backdoors FLATROOF and ROOFDECK, first seen in the LayerZero Labs attack. The victim is an India-based IT services provider with no crypto ties, reached through fake job-interview coding projects that used weaponized Terraform lock files. Both backdoors were on disk from March 18, 2026, and beaconing began March 29. A newer ROOFDECK version was deployed April 20 and beaconed to a new server until June 1. The report says delivery could not be proven and that much of the later infection activity is unknown.
